decisions.difference: A: Pigmented skin lesion (mole tasks)  vs  B: Melanocytic nevus
decisions.reason: The page says 'a mole', which is a melanocytic naevus; Pigmented skin lesion is broader. Neither builder's hierarchy claim holds (the concepts are unrelated by is-a).

decisions.difference: A: Pigmented skin lesion checked for in the lump task  vs  B: no mole item in the lump task
decisions.reason: The red box sits on the skin-lump page, so the lump task asks about a mole (A's structure) using the page's word 'mole' (B's concept).

decisions.difference: A: Bleeding skin  vs  B: Bleeds easily
decisions.reason: 'Bleeds easily' is the page's exact wording and an exact concept; Bleeding skin drops 'easily'.

decisions.difference: A: Diameter of lump (mm) > 6  vs  B: Lesion size, largest dimension (mm) > 6
decisions.reason: A mole is a lesion, not a lump; 'wide' is its largest dimension.

decisions.difference: A: Pain of skin  vs  B: Pain with finding_site Skin structure
decisions.reason: Same meaning ('painful'); the precoordinated concept is the is-a-narrower equivalent and needs no body-site attribute.

decisions.difference: A: Warm skin  vs  B: Temperature of skin over lesion warm
decisions.reason: 'warm lump' is warmth over the lesion, parallel to 'Redness of skin over lesion' which both builders used.

decisions.difference: A: one rule, Abscess of skin and/or subcutaneous tissue  vs  B: two rules, Furuncle and Abscess
decisions.final_expr: (diagnosis Furuncle probable) and (diagnosis Abscess of skin and/or subcutaneous tissue probable)
decisions.reason: The page names both 'boil/abscess', and Furuncle is not a descendant of the abscess concept, so one concept cannot cover both.

decisions.difference: A: Fluctuant AND Skin discharge  vs  B: (or Fluctuant Skin discharge)
decisions.reason: The page lists 'softens in the centre to discharge pus' as part of one conjunctive description; requiring both is closer to the words, but whether a not-yet-discharging boil counts is not settled.

decisions.difference: A: Papule of skin + Round shape + Raised (warts)  vs  B: plain Papule of skin
decisions.final_expr: (clinical_finding Papule of skin (qualifier Round shape) (qualifier Raised))
decisions.reason: 'Round, raised papules' — A keeps the page's qualifiers.

decisions.difference: A: Papule of skin + Small (molluscum)  vs  B: plain Papule of skin
decisions.reason: 'Small, skin-coloured pearly bumps' — 'small' is the page's word.

decisions.difference: A: palms/soles exclusion not encoded  vs  B: (no papule at palm) and (no papule at sole)
decisions.final_expr: (no (clinical_finding Papule of skin (finding_site Palm (region) structure))), (no (clinical_finding Papule of skin (finding_site Structure of sole of foot)))
decisions.reason: 'Does not involve palms/soles' is part of the page's description leading to 'Molluscum contagiosum likely'; the resulting gate findings are a known checker limitation, declared.

decisions.difference: A: Kaposi's sarcoma  vs  B: Kaposi's sarcoma of skin
decisions.reason: The page says 'Kaposi's sarcoma likely' and notes lesions in mouth and genitals too, so the skin-only concept is narrower than the page.

decisions.difference: A: subcutaneous mass Smooth+Well defined, Round+Firm, Soft+Painless  vs  B: Well defined, Firm, Soft, Painless as separate qualifiers
decisions.reason: A keeps 'smooth' and 'round', which are on the page; B dropped them.

decisions.difference: A: Lipoma  vs  B: Subcutaneous lipoma
decisions.reason: The page says 'Lipoma likely'; the subcutaneous evidence already localises it.

decisions.difference: A: OR of red papule, pustule, nodule, comedone  vs  B: comedone OR any2(papule, pustule, nodule)
decisions.final_expr: (or Papule of skin (Red color), Pustule, Skin nodule, Comedone)
decisions.reason: Neither is literal; the page's management treats 'blackheads only' and 'red and swollen areas' separately, supporting any one lesion type, while B's 'any 2' is a threshold the page never states; 'red' is the page's word.

decisions.difference: A: Acne  vs  B: Acne vulgaris
A: '(skin lump/s)' suffixes  vs  B: 'from a skin lump' / 'mole needing referral this week'
decisions.final_expr: A's descriptions; boil rules named 'Diagnose probable boil (skin lump/s)' and 'Diagnose probable skin abscess (skin lump/s)'
decisions.reason: Base build is A; names are topic-specific and unique.

notes: Both builders passed. Base A (keeps the page's qualifiers: round, raised, small, smooth, red, and the page's diagnosis names). From B: Melanocytic nevus for 'mole', Bleeds easily, Lesion size largest dimension, Temperature of skin over lesion warm, the separate Furuncle rule and the molluscum palms/soles exclusion (with B's four declared known_issues, a gate limitation on (no X) with a finding_site). Both builders claimed an is-a relation between Melanocytic nevus and Pigmented skin lesion in opposite directions; snomed is_a says neither holds, and notes were corrected. Remaining questions merged from both builders.
